{\sffamily\bfseries\LARGE Status metrics A--Z}\hfill{\sffamily\large quick reference}\par\vspace{3pt}
\hrule height 1.2pt\vspace{4pt}
{\small Frame: \emph{I put the system model under a DevSecOps pipeline for IAMD.}\quad Report the outcome and the count; every \N{} comes from its collection method (Appendix A of \texttt{docs/STATUS-METRICS.html}). The marker beside each group is the dashboard's, so a black-and-white print still tells them apart.}\par
\begin{multicols}{2}
\grp{\ding{110}}{Coverage}
\metric{A}{\% under configuration control}{goal 100\%}{\N{}\% of the IAMD architecture is now under configuration control as text, up from \N{}\%.\\ \N{} elements entered configuration control this sprint.}
\metric{B}{Segments gated}{goal: all}{\N{} of \N{} segments are now gated on every merge.\\ \N{} segments joined the pipeline this sprint.}
\metric{C}{Requirements linked}{goal: all}{\N{} of \N{} DOORS requirements are now linked to model elements.\\ \N{} requirements were linked this week.}
\metric{D}{Elements in baseline}{tracked}{Baseline \N{} holds \N{} elements, up \N{} from the last baseline.\\ \N{} new elements entered the baseline this sprint, all linted 0/0.}
\grp{\ding{108}}{Quality}
\metric{E}{Lint errors / warnings}{goal 0}{The model lints \N{} errors / \N{} warnings across \N{} elements.\\ All \N{} merges this sprint passed at 0/0.}
\metric{F}{Orphan requirements}{goal 0}{There are \N{} orphan requirements in [segment]. Last week there were \N{}.\\ \N{} orphans remain, and each has an owner.}
\metric{G}{Unverified requirements}{goal 0}{The trace found \N{} requirements with no verification method. They’re flagged to their owners.\\ Unverified requirements dropped from \N{} to \N{}.}
\metric{H}{Interface mismatches caught at merge}{none reach integration}{The pipeline caught \N{} interface mismatches before review. Under the old process, they would have been found at integration.\\ \N{} mismatches were caught at merge this sprint, and \N{} reached integration.}
\metric{I}{Trace completeness}{goal 100\%}{\N{}\% of requirements are traced satisfy-to-verify end to end.\\ \N{} of \N{} segments have a complete trace.}
\grp{\ding{115}}{Time and cost}
\metric{J}{Labor hours saved}{tracked}{Interface tables are now generated, not hand-built. That saves about \N{} labor hours per baseline.\\ That’s \N{} hours saved this quarter on [document type].}
\metric{K}{Regeneration time}{goal $\leq$ 15\,min}{ICD views now regenerate in \N{} minutes. The old process took \N{} days.\\ A full document set rebuilds from the model in \N{} minutes.}
\metric{L}{Documents generated, not hand-built}{goal: all}{\N{} of \N{} [document type] now come straight from the model.\\ Drawing plates now come from model views. That’s \N{} plates this sprint.}
\metric{M}{Hand edits}{goal 0}{Generated documents needed \N{} hand edits this sprint.\\ Hand edits to [document type] went from \N{} per baseline to \N{}.}
\metric{N}{Lead time}{goal $\leq$ 5\,d}{A model change now reaches a reviewed baseline in \N{} days. Before, it took \N{} days.\\ Median lead time from merge request to merge is \N{} hours.}
\grp{\ding{117}}{Digital thread}
\metric{O}{Parameters sourced from the model}{goal: all}{\N{} of \N{} sim parameters now come from the model, not spreadsheets.\\ \N{} parameters moved from spreadsheets to the model this sprint.}
\metric{P}{Sim runs pinned to a baseline}{goal: all}{\N{} of \N{} sim runs this sprint name the exact baseline that fed them.\\ \N{} sim results in this review trace to baseline \N{}.}
\grp{\ding{58}}{Risk retired}
\metric{Q}{Uncovered zone crossings}{goal 0}{There are \N{} uncovered zone crossings across \N{} interfaces.\\ \N{} interfaces cross a trust zone, and each one has a security requirement or it can’t merge.}
\metric{R}{Unmitigated threats}{goal 0}{All \N{} recorded threats are traced to a mitigation and a requirement.\\ Unmitigated threats went from \N{} to \N{}.}
\metric{S}{Reproducible baselines}{goal: all}{Baseline \N{} is tagged and reproducible. Any sim run can name the exact model that fed it.\\ \N{} baselines tagged to date, and \N{} of them rebuild identically.}
\metric{T}{Drift (model vs. documents)}{goal 0}{Drift between the model and the ICDs is \N{} lines, because they regenerate on every change.\\ Drift checks found \N{} discrepancies in legacy documents. They’re flagged for correction.}
\grp{\ding{72}}{Flow (agile)}
\metric{U}{Merges per sprint}{tracked}{\N{} model changes merged this sprint, all gated.\\ Merge volume went from \N{} to \N{} per sprint.}
\metric{V}{Change failure rate}{goal $\leq$ 15\%}{\N{}\% of merges needed a fix-forward, against a target of under \N{}\%.\\ \N{} merges were reverted this sprint.}
\metric{W}{Time to restore}{goal $\leq$ 4\,h}{A broken gate was restored in \N{} hours.\\ Median time to green after a failure is \N{} minutes.}
\metric{X}{Done \%}{goal $\geq$ 80\%}{This sprint, \N{}\% of committed items are done.\\ \N{} of \N{} [segment] items are done.}
\metric{Y}{Blocked days}{goal $\leq$ 3}{There were \N{} blocked days this sprint, all waiting on [runner/access/license].\\ Blocked days dropped from \N{} to \N{} after [fix].}
\metric{Z}{Active contributors}{goal: all}{\N{} of \N{} engineers merged a model change this sprint.\\ \N{} engineers have merged at least one model change to date.}
\end{multicols}

{\sffamily\bfseries\LARGE Reporting with A--Z}\hfill{\sffamily\large quick reference}\par\vspace{3pt}
\hrule height 1.2pt\vspace{2pt}
\begin{multicols}{2}
\head{The round-robin, in the status meeting}
Pick the three or four letters that moved; say each as its phrase, outcome first, count second, then what comes next:\par\vspace{3pt}
{\leftskip=1em\rightskip=1em\itshape \N{}\% of [segment] is now under the pipeline (A). \N{} new traces (C). \N{} interface mismatches caught at merge (H). Next: [segment].\par}
\vspace{3pt}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=1.1em,itemsep=1pt,topsep=2pt]
\item One letter, one sentence. Never a number without its letter, never a letter without its number.
\item Say what moved since last time; a metric that did not move is not news.
\item Bad news is a letter too: say it plainly (F orphans, Y blocked days) with the owner and the next step.
\item Every \N{} must be reproducible from the repo or its exports by the command in Appendix A.
\end{itemize}
\head{What the status words mean}
\begin{tabularx}{\linewidth}{@{}>{\sffamily\bfseries}l X@{}}
on target & At or past its goal (the goal is on the front, beside each metric).\\
improving & Not at its goal yet, but better than last time.\\
act & Not at its goal and not getting better: name an owner and a step.\\
tracking & No goal (D, J, U): report the trend.\\
no data & Nothing collected yet (W before the first broken gate).\\
\end{tabularx}
\head{The six groups, in one breath}
\begin{tabularx}{\linewidth}{@{}l>{\bfseries}l X@{}}
\ding{110} & Coverage (ABCD) & How much of the model is in the pipeline yet?\\
\ding{108} & Quality (EFGHI) & Is what is there correct and traceable?\\
\ding{115} & Time and cost (JKLMN) & What does it save against the old document process?\\
\ding{117} & Digital thread (OP) & Do analysis and simulation draw on the model?\\
\ding{58} & Risk retired (QRST) & What security and configuration risk has the pipeline closed?\\
\ding{72} & Flow (agile) (UVWXYZ) & Is the team delivering steadily?\\
\end{tabularx}
\columnbreak
\head{What moves which letter}
{\small\begin{tabularx}{\linewidth}{@{}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}X >{\sffamily\bfseries}l >{\raggedright\arraybackslash}X@{}}
\toprule
What I did & Moves & What I say\\
\midrule
Ported a v1 item & A, D, E & Under configuration control, gated at 0/0\\
Finished a segment & B, Z & Segment gated; its owner merges\\
Re-linked a DOORS requirement & C, F, G, I & Requirements linked; orphans and unverified surfaced; trace \%\\
Ported an interface & H, Q, T & Mismatches caught at merge; zone crossings covered; drift found\\
Replaced a hand-built table or view with a generated one & J, K, L, M & Hours saved; regeneration time; documents generated; hand edits\\
Tagged a baseline & D, S, N & Baseline size; reproducible; lead time\\
Wired a sim input to the model & O, P & Parameters sourced; runs pinned to a baseline\\
Ported a threat or mitigation & R & Unmitigated threats\\
Closed a sprint & U, V, W, X, Y & Merges; change failure; time to restore; done \%; blocked days\\
\bottomrule
\end{tabularx}}
\head{The dashboard}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=1.2em,itemsep=1pt,topsep=2pt]
\item Open \texttt{docs/STATUS-DASHBOARD.html} (one file, works offline).
\item Paste the week's \texttt{dashboard.json} into \emph{Data (JSON)}, then \emph{Apply}.
\item Tick the box on the tiles to say; \emph{Copy statement} gives the round-robin text.
\item Ctrl-P, Save as PDF: one landscape page for the report.
\end{enumerate}
\head{Collecting the numbers}
{\footnotesize\ttfamily
perl bin/status-metrics.pl init \textbackslash\\\hspace*{1em}--config metrics.json --xmi legacy.xmi --reqif export.reqif\\[1pt]
perl bin/status-metrics.pl collect \textbackslash\\\hspace*{1em}--config metrics.json --history history.jsonl\\[1pt]
perl bin/status-metrics.pl report \textbackslash\\\hspace*{1em}--config metrics.json --history history.jsonl --out report\par}
\vspace{3pt}{\small \texttt{init} once (freezes the denominators), \texttt{collect} daily, \texttt{report} weekly: \texttt{status-weekly.md}, \texttt{status-daily.csv}, \texttt{dashboard.json}. Help: \texttt{perl agile.pl help status-metrics}.}\par
\head{More}
{\small Definitions and collection methods: \texttt{docs/STATUS-METRICS.html}. The worked example, day by day (stand-ups, burn-downs, funding): \texttt{docs/HALBERD.pdf}.\par}
\end{multicols}
